rawRetro.summary: Repaired three rounds of verification failures: an ESLint gate error, a database-seed module-resolution failure on fresh startup, and a production Workflow run failure where materialized run modules could not import their packages because the Artifact store lived on the relocatable storage disk.

issues.title: ESLint no-unnecessary-type-assertion errors in service-request workflow
issues.symptom: pnpm lint failed with 2 errors in server/providers/service-request.ts:255 and server/workflows/service-request-acceptance/server/record-result.ts:21, blocking the factory lint gate.
issues.rootCause: The triggerRevision argument was cast to JsonObject although the receiver accepts the inferred object, and the workflow run step cast args.result to ServiceRequestResult after it had already been narrowed to 'normal' | 'urgent', which is exactly that type.
issues.resolution: Removed both redundant assertions; also dropped the now-unused ServiceRequestResult type import in record-result.ts. Verified with scoped eslint on both files, tsc -p tsconfig.server.json, and the three service-request logic test files (36 tests).

issues.title: Database seeds failed on fresh startup: relative .js imports cannot resolve under native Node type stripping
issues.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts failed in 'starts a fresh Default ...' and 'serves Users and API Keys ...' with AppDatabaseTaskError: Database seeds failed for connection "main": Cannot find module '/.../database/seed-data/service-request-fixtures.js' imported from database/main/seeds/202610100002_service_request_test_users.ts. 393 passed, 2 failed.
issues.rootCause: The seed/migration loader in @nocobase/db imports task files with a native dynamic import() (a file URL with an ?mtime cache-buster), which is not processed by Vite/vitest or tsx. Node 24 runs the .ts source via type stripping, but its ESM resolver does not remap a relative '.js' specifier to the '.ts' file, so every seed's import of '../../seed-data/*.js' and the permission helper's import of '../../server/service-request-model.js' failed at ERRs_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The template enables allowImportingTsExtensions + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions precisely so task sources can name relative '.ts' imports that compile back to '.js'.
issues.resolution: Changed the relative specifiers to '.ts' in the four service-request seed files and in database/seed-data/service-request-permissions.ts. Verified: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json passes; the previously failing tests/logic/app-server.test.ts and tests/logic/service-request-permissions.test.ts now pass (34 tests); the other three service-request logic files pass (36 tests); and a scoped tsc emit confirms the compiled dist rewrites the specifiers back to '.js', so the deployed seed loader resolves them.

issues.title: Workflow run nodes failed with Cannot find package '@nocobase/db' because Artifacts were materialized outside the application tree
issues.symptom: Clicking Accept POSTed /api/service-requests/<id>/accept and returned 202, but the run failed at node registerAcceptance with 'Cannot find package @nocobase/db imported from .../storage/private/workflows/service-request-acceptance/<digest>/server/acceptance.js'. Both urgent and normal requests stayed status 'pending' with result null, the urgent branch never ran, and neither the assignee nor the supervisor message center showed any in-app message, so recipient and receipt verification failed.
issues.rootCause: Workflow run modules import runtime values: databaseManagerToken (@nocobase/db), notificationServiceToken (@nocobase/app-plugin-notification/server), i18nToken (@nocobase/app-server/i18n) and APP_NS (@nocobase/i18n/server). The Workflow plugin resolves the Artifact directory and loads its modules with a plain Node import(), so bare specifiers resolve by walking up from that directory. The application's default 'local' Artifact disk pointed at paths.storage(), which the deployment may relocate outside the code tree; the verify config placed it under an external repair-state directory with no reachable node_modules, so resolution failed. The built Artifacts under dist/server/workflows were fine but were never used because the plugin always materializes through the Artifact store.
issues.resolution: Added a private fs disk 'workflowArtifacts' at paths.server() (the compiled server tree, where the deployment installs node_modules) in server/config/drive.ts, and pointed workflow.artifactDisk at it in server/config/workflow.ts. The store root now coincides with the built Artifact root (dist/server/workflows), so the existing build is read in place with no copy, and Node resolves the run modules' package imports through dist/node_modules. Configuration merge is deep, so the deployment's drive override that relocates the storage disk no longer moves the Artifact store. Added assertions to tests/logic/config.test.ts covering the new disk and artifactDisk value.
issues.verification: Scoped checks: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit; eslint on both changed config files; prettier --check; vitest tests/logic/config.test.ts, service-request-acceptance.test.ts, service-request-routes.test.ts, service-request-permissions.test.ts (39 tests). End-to-end against the production build with the verify-3 external-storage config: created one urgent and one normal request and accepted both; runs 3 and 4 completed, records became accepted_urgent/urgent and accepted_normal/normal, exactly one persistent in-app message was created per run for the assignee (bodies correctly distinguish urgent from normal), and marking one read persisted (unread count 2 -> 1 with readAt retained on re-list). No module-resolution error appeared in the run log, and the external workflow directory received no new commits.

严格保持来源预设的最小受理与站内通知范围，使用框架现有 Workflow 和站内通知能力，不自建任务引擎，不扩展复杂审批、外部通知渠道或额外业务模块。通过真实业务操作触发流程，检查原案例要求的状态变化、通知接收与异常路径，不用固定返回值或前端假通知冒充实际流程执行。

真实执行 Agent 搭建、已有工厂检查、浏览器业务验收、独立终验与完整框架评测；PR、HTML 报告、截图和交互归档沿用工厂机制。不自行重复整条流水线，不降低验收门禁，不自动合并业务 PR。失败、阻塞和未知项如实记录。

retro.summary: Repaired three rounds of verification failures: an ESLint gate error, a database-seed module-resolution failure on fresh startup, and a production Workflow run failure where materialized run modules could not import their packages because the Artifact store lived on the relocatable storage disk.

buildReview.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。

evaluation.summary: 本次是以 Workflow 与持久站内通知为唯一范围的回归。评估覆盖 app-plugin-workflow、app-plugin-notification、app-plugin-notification-in-app 三个能力单元及其 Skill 指引。框架的 DSL/条件分支/run 节点/持久执行记录、Notification 的 Channel-Provider 发送与幂等、In-App 持久收件箱（用户隔离、CSRF、已读持久化、公开 Client 组件）在 QA 第 4 轮均真实通过。主要缺口是 Workflow 公开服务契约只有 trigger(key)/registerInstruction：应用自有 source workflow 在新部署没有 current revision 时 trigger(key) 只会得到 skipped: not-found，Agent 只能本地扩展接口调用未公开的 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision 并传 force/waitForCompletion 才能由业务动作触发。该绕行违反 Skill 明示的“只用公开导出、不得绕过插件内部”。通知与站内收件箱两项为直接支持且契约与 Skill 描述一致。

modules.name: Workflow DSL、条件分支与执行记录
modules.scope: source-managed workflow 的定义、输入 schema、RunInstruction 与 ConditionInstruction 分支、run 模块结果校验、持久 run/nodeRun 记录，以及业务侧触发（trigger）契约。
modules.limitations: 未评估 Artifact 构建、scheduler 触发、管理 UI 的历史版本运行与 node 重跑；本次未覆盖失败/超时的执行路径。

requirements.need: 主管点击受理后由现有 Workflow 执行“登记受理→按紧急标记分支→发送通知”，执行记录能看到步骤与最终结果（B01/B03）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 DSL、条件分支、run 节点执行、持久执行历史与触发 API；应用负责 workflow 源码、run 模块业务逻辑与触发时机。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 server/workflows/<key>/workflow.ts 用 defineWorkflow + RunInstruction/ConditionInstruction 编写并校验；业务触发从容器解析 workflowServiceToken 调 trigger(key, input, { eventKey }) 并处理 accepted/skipped。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 按 DSL 正确编写 workflow.ts 与 run 模块（E10、E11、E12）。但 trigger(key) 在全新部署无 current revision 时只会 skipped: not-found，Agent 把 workflowServiceToken 转成自建 WorkflowRuntime 接口，调用未公开的 discoverArtifacts()/ensureArtifactMaterialized()/triggerRevision() 并传 force+waitForCompletion 触发（E9）。无法从日志确认 Agent 是否读过 invocation 指引，但其代码与指引推荐的 trigger(key) 路径不同。

requirements.need: 普通与紧急请求走出不同的受理结果，并能在执行记录中确认实际分支（B01/B03）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责条件节点的布尔表达式求值与 yes/no 分支调度、分支结果的持久化；应用负责定义判断表达式与各分支的 run 模块。
requirements.recommendedUsage: ConditionInstruction.create({ key, description, config: { expression } }).branch({ yes: [...], no: [...] })，表达式须求值为 boolean。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 {'===': [{ var: 'nodeResults.registerAcceptance.urgent' }, true]} 分支，QA 看到运行 #1 Is the request urgent?=false、运行 #2 =true，两个分支对应节点 Succeeded 并生成不同业务结果（E11、E25）。

requirementFit.reason: DSL、条件分支与持久执行记录直接满足 B01/B03，QA 第 4 轮真实通过；但业务动作可靠触发一个全新部署的应用自有 workflow 需要绕开公开契约（E1、E2、E9），属于框架职责内的明显小缺口，故未达 90。

usability.reason: 编写与校验 workflow 的路径清楚、QA 也确认执行记录可读；但公开的 trigger 契约在 source workflow 未 materialize 时只返回 not-found，应用必须以类型断言调用三个未公开方法并传 force/waitForCompletion 才能由受理动作触发（E1、E2、E9），装配成本明显。

agentFriendliness.reason: DSL 指引对节点描述、result schema、isolatedDeclarations、`workflow check` 等前提写得很具体（E6、E4）；但指引只示范 trigger(key, input, {eventKey})，未说明全新部署如何让应用自有 workflow 成为 current/enabled，也未记录公开 WorkflowEventOptions 中的 force/manually/waitForCompletion（E7），Agent 只能自行绕过。

design.reason: 公开 WorkflowServiceContract 只有 registerInstruction 与 trigger(key)，而 WorkflowService 另外实现了 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision；internalWorkflowServiceToken 存在却未从 ./server 入口再导出（E2、E3），导致“应用自有、零人工启用”的触发路径没有公开抽象，应用只能本地复制内部接口。

reliability.reason: trigger/triggerRevision 在调度前校验 enabled（除非 force/manually）、inputSchema 与输入大小，并对结果做 JSON 可序列化校验（E1、E5）；条件节点强制表达式求值为 boolean 且按 yes/no 分支调度（E4）。QA 显示两个分支与节点均按预期 Resolved/Succeeded。

modules.name: Notification 发送核心与 Channel/Provider
modules.scope: Channel 名到 Provider 配置的映射、notificationServiceToken.send 的完整消息契约、逻辑发送幂等、recipient 校验与 Delivery 异步投递。
modules.limitations: 本次只用 inbox（in-app）Channel；未评估 SMTP/Resend/Webhook Provider、重试与 unknown/partial 恢复路径。

requirements.need: 受理后向负责人发送一条持久站内消息，不使用成功 toast、内存列表或另建消息表（B02）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 Channel/Provider 注册、消息校验、幂等与持久 Delivery；应用负责配置 Channel 与消息内容。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 notification.channels 把 inbox 映射到 provider: in-app；解析 notificationServiceToken 后 send({ idempotencyKey, source, messages: { inbox: { to, title, body, target: { type: 'route', path } } } })。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 config/notification.ts 配置 channels: { inbox: { provider: 'in-app' } }（E18），并在 run 模块里按同一形状调用 notification.send（E12），与指引示例一致。

requirements.need: 消息能对应到具体业务请求与收件人，且重复受理不产生重复消息。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 idempotencyKey/source 关联与基于事件键的去重；应用选择稳定的幂等键与收件人 id。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 同一逻辑请求复用稳定 idempotencyKey，source 写业务类型/引用，messages 中 to 用应用用户 id。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 idempotencyKey: `service-request-accepted:${requestId}`、source: { type: 'service-request', referenceId }、to: assigneeId（E12）；框架对相同 fingerprint 去重、不同 fingerprint 抛 conflict（E14）。

requirementFit.reason: 框架用配置的 in-app Channel 真实投递持久消息，Agent 接入与 sending-notifications 指引示例逐字对应（E14、E17、E18），B02 业务结果由 In-App 收件箱进一步兑现。

usability.reason: 只需一处 Channel 配置加一次 send，消息形状、recipient 类型与 route target 都写在指引里；send 在持久化前原子校验 channel 与消息（E14、E16、E17）。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确给出 notificationServiceToken、完整 send 示例、route/url target 语义与幂等规则，Agent 可直接照用（E16、E17），无需探索内部实现。

design.reason: Channel（名）与 Provider（类型）解耦，send 以 messages 按 Channel 名分派，source/idempotencyKey 与投递状态查询是公开契约（E14、E15、E17）；未使用旧的 actionUrl 或隐式当前用户。

reliability.reason: send 在任何持久化前完成 idempotency 校验与逐 Channel 消息校验，重复键按 requestFingerprint 去重或报冲突，随后才创建 Notification/Delivery 并异步 dispatch（E14）。

modules.name: 持久站内收件箱（In-App）
modules.scope: in-app Channel/Provider 注册、持久 inbox 项与每用户隔离、认证 HTTP API（list/unread-count/read/unread/delete/read-all）、CSRF、已读持久化、公开 Client 收件箱组件与 target 跳转。
modules.limitations: 未查看截图做视觉评审；未评估 realtime 断线重连全矩阵与 Dev Route 生产裁剪，仅按现有指引与实现确认范围。

requirements.need: 负责人用现有消息中心收到消息，点击能打开对应请求（B02）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 inbox 持久化、HTTP/实时失效与公开 Client 组件；应用负责在认证 App 路由挂载收件箱并提供可跳转的 target。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 先注册 notification 再注册 in-app 的 /server，客户端注册 /client；在认证路由内用 NotificationInAppProvider 包住 NotificationInAppInbox；target 用 { type:'route', path }。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 server/client 插件列表里按 requirement 顺序注册（E21、E23），在 app/client/pages/messages.tsx 挂载插件公开组件（E13、E22），发送侧写 route target（E12）。

requirements.need: 标记已读刷新后仍为已读，且非收件人看不到个人消息（B02/B04）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 read/unread 写入持久化、每用户过滤与 CSRF 保护；应用负责正确渲染与调用。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 通过插件 inbox 的读取/变更 API 操作，服务端以会话用户过滤；不变更 inbox 表或伪造实时事件。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 直接使用插件收件箱组件；实现按用户 id 过滤 list/count/update，路由中间件从认证会话取用户并要求 CSRF（E19、E20、E21）。QA 观察到 2 unread→标记已读→刷新/重登仍为已读，且主管与管理员消息中心为空（E25）。

requirementFit.reason: In-App 插件提供持久 inbox、按用户隔离、已读持久化与公开 Client 组件，直接满足 B02/B04；QA 用两个不同角色确认消息仅收件人可见且已读跨刷新/重登保留（E19、E20、E24、E25）。

usability.reason: 接入只需在插件列表注册 /server 与 /client 并挂载公开的 Provider+Inbox 组件，target 传 route 即可跳转（E22、E23、E13、E24）。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 给出必须的包与注册顺序、公开导入路径、生产路由要求、CSRF/分页/用户隔离验证清单，Agent 照做且未触达 server 内部模块（E23、E24）。

design.reason: Server 侧注册 in-app Channel/Provider 并注入 recipientExists，Store 抽象同时提供内存与数据库实现；Client 只暴露 Provider/Inbox 与 realtime topic 的公开入口（E21、E19、E22），边界清晰。

reliability.reason: 所有 inbox 查询/更新都以 userId 作为过滤条件，delete/read/unread 在缺失或非本人时返回未找到；POST 端点校验 CSRF，未认证返回 401（E19、E20）。Provider 写库前用 userAdministrationServiceToken 校验收件人存在（E21）。

findings.title: Workflow 公开契约无法让应用在新部署中 materialize/触发自有 source workflow
findings.detail: 公开的 WorkflowServiceContract 只有 registerInstruction 与 trigger(key,...)，而 trigger 只查 key+current 的 workflows 行，没有 current revision 时直接返回 { status: 'skipped', reason: 'not-found' }（E1）；materialize/激活所需的 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision 只存在于未导出的 WorkflowService，internalWorkflowServiceToken 也未从 ./server 入口再导出（E2、E3）。因此应用自有 workflow 若不先由管理员在管理 UI 启用，就无法按推荐的 trigger(key) 由业务动作触发。Agent 只能把 workflowServiceToken 断言成自建接口并调用内部方法，传 force:true 绕过启用开关、waitForCompletion:true 等待结果（E9），与 Skill 明示的“只用公开导出、不得绕过插件内部”相冲突。
findings.impact: 业务触发路径依赖插件内部方法与本地类型复制，公开契约与实现不一致；管理 UI 会显示启用开关为关闭，而受理动作仍能产生真实运行记录，容易让运维/后续 Agent 误判 workflow 状态。
findings.suggestedChange: 为应用自有 workflow 提供并文档化公开的 materialize/activate + 触发入口（例如公开导出 internalWorkflowServiceToken 或增加 WorkflowServiceContract.materializeAndTrigger），或在 Skill 中明确“部署时必须先启用该 workflow 才能 trigger(key)”，并让管理 UI 反映应用强制触发的实际状态。

findings.title: Workflow invocation 指引未说明 source workflow 如何成为 current，也未记录公开的 trigger 选项
findings.detail: SKILL.md 要求只用公开导出，invocation 指引只示范 trigger(key, input, { eventKey })（E6、E7）。执行诊断文档虽列出 skipped: not-found 对应“no current revision, source not loaded”，但没有任何“应用自有 workflow 在全新部署如何 materialize/激活”的操作路径；同时公开 WorkflowEventOptions 里的 force/manually/waitForCompletion/sourceType/sourceId 均未在 Skill 中被提及。
findings.impact: Agent 遇到 not-found 时缺少官方向导，倾向于探测插件内部实现，增加接入时间与错误风险。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 invocation-and-service-api.md 增加“应用自有 source workflow 的首次激活/触发”小节，说明 materialize、enable 与 force 触发的区别和推荐做法，并补充 WorkflowEventOptions 的公开字段说明。

findings.title: Notification 发送契约与本次需求及 Skill 示例完全对应
findings.detail: notificationServiceToken.send 以 idempotencyKey + source + messages.<channel> 为核心，在持久化前完成幂等与消息校验，重复键按 fingerprint 去重或报冲突（E14、E15）；sending-notifications.md 的 inbox 示例（to/title/body/target route）与 Agent 实际代码逐字一致（E17）。
findings.impact: 应用无需自建消息表或 toast 兜底即可获得持久、可去重、可关联业务的发送语义。
findings.suggestedChange: 无需改动；可作为同类通知需求的推荐范式。

findings.title: In-App 收件箱以用户隔离和已读持久化为默认行为，并提供公开组件
findings.detail: Store 的 list/countUnread/update/markAllRead 全部以 userId 限定，update 对非本人或不存在项返回 undefined（E19、E20）；Provider 写库前通过 userAdministrationServiceToken 校验收件人存在（E21）；Client 入口公开 NotificationInAppProvider/Inbox（E22），Agent 直接挂载即得真实持久收件箱。
findings.impact: B02/B04 的用户隔离、已读持久化和“点击打开请求”无需应用重复实现。

evidence.observation: trigger(workflowKey) 只查 key+current 行，缺行返回 skipped:not-found，未启用且非 force/manually 返回 disabled；triggerRevision/discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized 均在此类，但公开契约未导出。
公开 WorkflowServiceContract 只声明 registerInstruction 与 trigger；internalWorkflowServiceToken 虽在此文件声明但不随 ./server 入口导出。
./server 公开入口只再导出 workflowServiceToken、WorkflowServiceContract 类型、JsonObject/WorkflowEventOptions/WorkflowTriggerReceipt、Instruction 与 runtime config，未包含 internal token。
ConditionInstruction.run 求值表达式，非 boolean 抛 TypeError，按 yes/no 找分支并保存 RESOLVED 结果后调度分支节点。
assertWorkflowRunResult 拒绝循环引用、BigInt/函数/symbol、非有限数字与非普通对象，保证 run 结果可经 nodeRun 持久化往返。
Skill 规定应用拥有 workflow 源码与触发时机，插件拥有 DSL/执行/历史/管理 API，并要求只用公开导出、不得绕过插件内部。
evidence.excerpt:
Use NocoBase 3's source-managed Workflow implementation where business behavior needs a durable, inspectable process lifecycle. Keep atomic operations, calculations, data access, and integrations in typed code, whether called directly or from a workflow `run` node. Do not invent DSL fields, node types, service methods, or runtime behavior.

The application owns workflow source packages, business services, trigger timing, authentication and authorization, business idempotency, and compensation policy. The plugin owns the DSL and core Instructions, Artifact and execution lifecycle, persisted history, management API, and diagnostic views. Use public package exports and APIs; do not bypass them through plugin internals or materialized tables.

evidence.observation: 业务触发示例只演示 trigger(key, input, {eventKey})，选项说明仅列 eventKey/parentRunId，并只说明可能 skipped；未给 source workflow 首次激活路径，也未提及 force/manually/waitForCompletion。
Agent 把 workflowServiceToken 断言为自建 WorkflowRuntime，调用未公开的 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision，并传 force:true、waitForCompletion:true、eventKey/sourceType/sourceId，再处理 skipped。
用 defineWorkflow 定义 inputSchema（requestId/locale），首个 RunInstruction 读取 requestId 返回 assigneeId/urgent/title 的 result schema。
ConditionInstruction 以 {'===':[{var:'nodeResults.registerAcceptance.urgent'},true]} 分支，yes 走 recordUrgentResult、no 走 recordNormalResult。
run 模块解析 notificationServiceToken，调用 send({idempotencyKey:'service-request-accepted:<id>', source:{type:'service-request',referenceId}, messages:{inbox:{to,title,body,target:{type:'route',path}}}})。
MessagesPage 使用插件公开的 NotificationInAppProvider 包住 NotificationInAppInbox，并注册为认证 App 路由而非 Dev Route。
send 按 Channel 校验消息与 recipient、计算 requestFingerprint，命中同 idempotencyKey 时按 fingerprint 去重或抛 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT，否则进入 sendExpanded 持久化并 dispatch。
包根公开导出 tokens（notificationServiceToken）、manager（send 相关类型/异常）、idempotency、store、types 与 shared target 校验。
Skill 指引发送时解析 notificationServiceToken、按 Channel 名构造完整消息、使用原生 recipient 地址，并在发送前验证预期外部效果。
evidence.excerpt:
1. Read [Notification concepts](references/notification-concepts.md) for package ownership and delivery status semantics.
2. For plugin registration, configuration, migrations, or test APIs, read [Integration and configuration](references/integration-and-configuration.md). Configure a Channel name mapped to one flat Provider configuration.
3. For sending or typed consumers, read [Sending notifications](references/sending-notifications.md). Resolve `notificationServiceToken`; construct complete messages keyed by Channel name and use native recipient addresses. Validate the intended external effect before sending.
4. For failures and retries, read [Delivery diagnostics](references/delivery-diagnostics.md). Preserve Notification, Delivery, Attempt, and retry-audit history; distinguish accepted submission from final delivery.
5. For custom transports, read [Channel and Provider extensions](references/channel-and-provider-extensions.md). Register globally unique Provider definitions through `notificationExtensionRegistryToken` and retain the queue/lease/retry lifecycle.
6. Verify changed packages and consumers with lint, typecheck, tests, and build. Cover atomic validation, independent delivery, recipient rules, and retries bound to original identities.

evidence.observation: 示例给出 inbox:{to,title,body,target:{type:'route',path}}；说明 in-app 收件人须为应用用户 id、最终投递校验用户存在、route target 由 Router 加 basename、idempotencyKey 复用规则。
应用配置 notification.channels = { inbox: { provider: 'in-app' } }，注释说明 In-app 插件在 boot 时注册 in-app Provider。
路由中间件从会话解析 userId（缺失返回 401），GET / 与 /unread-count 按 notificationUserId 过滤；read-all 与 POST /:id 校验 CSRF，只接受 read/unread/delete，store.update 带 userId。
DatabaseInAppStore.list/countUnread 以 userId 过滤并按 createdAt+id 排序分页；update 读/删/改均带 userId 条件，非本人项返回 undefined；readAt 写入实现已读持久化。
boot 时注册 createInAppChannelDefinition 与 createDatabaseProviderDefinition，recipientExists 通过 userAdministrationServiceToken 的 users.get(userId) 校验用户存在。
Client 入口公开导出 inbox/provider 组件、api、runtime、subscription 与 routes，使用方无需导入实现文件。

# Workflow

1. Read [Inbox Integration Contract](references/inbox-integration.md) for package requirements, public surfaces, and runtime semantics.
2. Inspect the target application's Server plugin list, Client composition, authentication setup, `api.baseURL`, `api.realtimeURL`, and installed package versions.
3. Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification` before `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/server` when the application needs the `in-app` Channel contribution.

evidence.observation: 契约列出必需包与注册顺序、浏览器只从 /realtime 导入 topic、客户端组件挂载在生产认证路由、Provider 写库前经 userAdministrationServiceToken 校验收件人存在。
evidence.excerpt:
Register the core notification Server plugin before the in-app Server plugin. The in-app routes can operate without the core plugin, but notification delivery through the `in-app` Channel cannot.

## Public surfaces

The package root and `/server` export the Server plugin and supported Server contracts. Browser or shared code imports only the topic and event types from:

```ts
import {
  IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_REALTIME_TOPIC,
  type InAppNotificationRealtimeEvent,
} from '@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/realtime';
```

Do not import `server/realtime`, store implementations, or other internal implementation paths from application code.

The package's Client plugin contributes this development-only App-relative route:

```text
/dev/notification-in-app
```

Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client` in the application Client composition root. The page mounts `NotificationInAppProvider` locally and cleans up its realtime and focus listeners when navigation leaves the page. The Dev Route and its exclusive dependencies are absent from production builds.

## Final delivery validation

The database Provider checks the recipient through Authentication’s user administration service immediately before writing the inbox item. A missing user returns a non-retryable `recipient` failure and creates no inbox item or realtime event. A lookup failure remains a retryable storage failure. Custom hosts calling `createDatabaseProviderDefinition` must supply `recipientExists(userId)` backed by their authoritative user directory; do not use a permissive fallback.
